negative_invariants.description: FR-001: the two retired senders 'batch_sync' and 'sync_all_queued_events' define nothing in sync/batch.py. Pattern pins the DEFINITION form ('def <name>') on purpose: both names still appear in the module's own docstring at batch.py:4, which explains what was removed, so a bare-name grep would report still_present on a correct tree. Positive control (proves grep reads the scoped file): 'def categorize_error' -> exit 0. Negative control (the naive pattern): 'batch_sync' -> exit 0, i.e. it would false-red. Non-vacuity: appending 'def batch_sync(' + 'def sync_all_queued_events(' to a copy of the file makes this pattern exit 0. Measured by WP02 at b0482a832; K=91 retired nodes dispositioned per node id at c187d1e9a.

NFR-001: zero transmit primitives remain in sync/batch.py. NFR-001's baseline was measured, not asserted: 3 senders (batch_sync direct via requests.post:1125 and request_with_stdlib_fallback_sync:1212,:1282; _fetch_advertised_sync_ingress_limits direct via requests.get:223; sync_all_queued_events transitively) out of 45 top-level callables, and the probe was controlled first against the four transmit sites the WP prompt named before the count was trusted. Post-deletion the same enumeration yields 0, so 3 -> 0. Pattern requires a CALL (an open paren) because the module docstring at batch.py:21 warns 'Do not add a requests.* or request_with_stdlib_fallback_sync call here' -- negative control 'requests\.' -> exit 0, i.e. the naive pattern false-reds on that warning. Non-vacuity: appending a requests.post(...) and a request_with_stdlib_fallback_sync(...) call to a copy of the file makes this pattern exit 0.

Pattern pins the ENTRY form 'inventory_id="E15"' because the file deliberately retains an explanatory NOTE at :576-583 recording that E15 was removed and must not be re-added -- negative control 'E15' -> exit 0, i.e. a bare-token grep would false-red on the very note that documents the removal. Positive control (proves grep reads the scoped file AND that sibling entries are untouched): 'inventory_id="E14"' -> exit 0. Non-vacuity: appending an Allowance(..., inventory_id="E15") line to a copy of the file makes this pattern exit 0.
